purpose: A registry of page warmers that start a page's cache loads before the person asks: each warmer is started once per workspace within the stale window and not while it runs, heavy ones are skipped on save-data or a slow link, and the picture count ahead follows the screen width.
namedChanges: only the generic part is taken: the types `WarmContext` and `Warmer`, `setWarmContext`, `registerWarm`, `network`, `heavyPrefetchOk`, `prefetchPictureCount`, `setPrefetchClock`, `prefetchPage`, `prefetchAll`, `onIdle`, and the "started" dedupe. The five warm functions, the five registrations and the imports of the source app's modules stay in the source app;

the module-level state becomes `createPrefetchRegistry(options)`, which returns the same functions over the same state; `onIdle` stays a plain export. Nothing runs at import (the source registered with the person hub when the module loaded: the factory does it when it is called);

`WarmContext` was `{ vault: VaultClient; ws; drafts?; principal? }` and is now `{ ws: string; vault: unknown }`, and the registry is generic over a context type that extends it; the warmers receive the host's own object;
`STALE_MS`, imported from the session cache, is the option `staleMs`, default 30 000 (the same number);

the picture counts (3 wide, 2 narrow) and the 640 px edge are the options `wideCount`, `narrowCount`, `narrowBelow`, with those values as defaults; `network` can be given through the option `network`;
the name it registers under with the person hub is the option `cacheName`, default "prefetch";
`getWarmContext()` is new: the source's warm functions read the module's `context` directly; a host's warm functions read it through this;
the header comment loses its cycle tags and the source app's page names.
